_comment: Short excerpts, verbatim, from Irfan Ahmad Khan's "An Understanding and Interpretation of [Surah]" essays in An Introduction to Understanding the Qur'an with Examples (2011). Ellipses mark material omitted for length; wording, punctuation, and emphasis otherwise unchanged. See sources.html for the full citation.

96.excerpt: Sūrah al-'Alaq initiated a qur'anic movement, calling the Prophet to "read" — the Book that will be sent down in installments over twenty three years. The reading takes place in the context of well-to-do people who are acting as transgressors in forgetfulness of their accountability to the Lord of Humankind. […] The Qur'anic Movement should continue disregarding all external pressures: "Do not submit to any pressure; prostrate to get closer to your Lord."

103.excerpt: The Qur'an is concerned that the purpose of Man's creation is fulfilled and human beings achieve al-Falāh (Ultimate Success & Happiness). To attain this objective, the sūrah starts with a warning, by way of reminding, but ends up with good news which is tied with a clear-cut program of action. […] Today again, there is transgression against God. There is corruption everywhere on earth. The message of the prophets of God is totally neglected. Humanity is (again) heading toward self-destruction!

107.excerpt: The sūrah repudiates pseudo-religiosity. It differentiates the true religiosity from the false religiosity. […] One should not be deceived by their worship (salāh) of God which is merely a public show; otherwise, their hearts are devoid of any real consciousness of God. Such worshippers are doomed!!

108.excerpt: The Qur'an, which has been given to the Prophet, is an unending source of Divine Blessings. It is the greatest gift from the Creator to the human world at the end of the prophetic movement. […] Then, prayer is not sufficient. Sacrifice is also a must. […] The sūrah concludes with the good news: The Qur'anic Movement will prosper more and more! The hatred and enmity against the Qur'anic Movement will go on decreasing… until it withers away completely!!

109.excerpt: There should be no compromise in the fundamental principles of the Religion. If it becomes clear that the addressees have in fact already decided that they are not going to believe, then there is no use in continuing the argument with them. […] "You follow your way. I will follow my way. In spite of differences in our approaches, we can live peacefully in the same society. Freedom of religion is essential! We want it for ourselves. And we give it to others."

112.excerpt: The sūrah explains that God is the Being on whom all other beings depend and God does not depend on any other being. Therefore, the first and the foremost truth about God is that God does not have any duality or plurality in God's Being. There is One and only One God. […] In a nutshell, God is a Unique Being: No one is like God.
